title: The Shill - More Hate & Moni Maybe
author: Ok-Investment4414
selftext:
So the anti ai factions are rather upset , new complains are surfacing as members of the digital skills liberation federation (pro ai ) are now cheaply reducing years of hard work pain and suffering down to a weekend and a x5 max plan. Copying games before their release and releasing them not as 100% clone but enough to make the originator. Angry

And I thought 👀have there been no reports of older massively successful titles copied? This would be in 2 variants single releases games with no plan of a sequel and the same but with an active community craving a similar game. 

Or has all those itches already been solved with newer games . Btw i know a fair amount of marketing is also required
